justification: CNO 2511, 2512, 2513, 2519 and 2521 link only to CIUO 2511-2519. Codes differ from CIUO (CNO 2512 'Especialistas programadores' = CIUO 2514; CNO 2521 'Especialistas en soporte de sistemas' = CIUO 2511 per INEI).
warnings: CNO 2511 'Analistas de sistemas' is 82% of the persona. CIUO 2512 (software developers) is reached only through CNO 2519 (Annex 4, relative link). Sensitivity without CNO 2521: -0.7%.
Only 5 records: point estimate suppressed. INEI coding concentrates IT professionals in CNO 2511. Use Personas 1+2 combined (COMB_P01_P02) as the robust reading.

justification: CNO 3511-3514, 3521, 3522 (same numbers as CIUO) plus CNO 3126 'Supervisores de servicios TIC' (INEI link to CIUO 3514 only).

Peru codes most designers (interior, product, fashion, packaging) to CNO 3432 'Disenadores y decoradores', which INEI links to CIUO 3432 (technician level, outside the persona). CNO 3432 (63,189) is reported as informational outside any ring; it is not added to persona 5.

justification: CNO 2412 'Analistas y asesores financieros y de inversiones' = CIUO 2412 + 2413 (CNO has no 2413).
